__comment: IRC->EventSub migration readiness, measured by GRANTED CHAT SCOPE rather than chat traffic. Backed by the eventsub_twitch_migration_sources gauge emitted by twitch-eventsub-listener (services/twitch-eventsub-listener/scopeexport). Unlike the 'IRC-active channels' panels on the twitch-irc-eventsub-migration dashboard -- which infer 'on IRC' from listener_messages_received_total and are skewed by demand-gated IRC fallback traffic, so they surface already-migrated channels and never drain to zero -- these panels read the authoritative config fact and are the correct gate for the IRC listener sunset (ADR-0026). Import standalone, or copy the panels into the existing migration dashboard. Requires the metric to be deployed first.
title: Twitch IRC -> EventSub Migration (by chat scope)

panels.title: Will lose Twitch chat at enforce
panels.description: Distinct active Twitch channels EventSub cannot serve (no chat scope). This is the real ADR-0026 enforce blast radius -- drive it to zero (minus the structural no-cred set) before flipping warn->enforce. NOT the 'IRC-active channels' count, which never drains.

panels.title: Re-consent backlog (nudge can fix)
panels.description: Unscoped channels whose owner HAS a credential but never granted user:read:chat. Re-adding the Twitch source migrates them; the ADR-0026 warn-phase in-overlay notice targets exactly these. This is the actionable backlog.

panels.title: No Twitch credential on file (needs Twitch link)
panels.description: Active unscoped channels with no Twitch OAuth token on file. Usually own-channels whose owner logged in via another platform (YouTube/Kick) and added the Twitch source without linking Twitch -- fixable by linking a Twitch credential with user:read:chat (ADR-0016 cross-platform consent), which the same warn-phase nudge drives. Permanent only when the channel owner has no all-chat account at all (true third-party). Until linked, served by IRC and lost at enforce.

panels.title: Migration state over time (distinct Twitch channels)
panels.description: Active Twitch channels (active source + active overlay) bucketed by chat-scope state. scoped = migrated; unscoped_has_cred = nudgeable backlog; unscoped_no_cred = structural (can never migrate). Watch scoped rise and unscoped_has_cred fall toward zero -- that, not 'IRC-active channels', is migration progress.

panels.title: % migrated (scoped / total)
panels.description: Share of active Twitch channels that have granted chat scope. 100% is unreachable while any no-cred channels remain configured; track it alongside the no-cred count.
